(2) objectui#12208 PR-1 folded as commit `df83ebef` on ruling 6121816480: the matrix 8 → 12 with every pin of the count moved (ci.yml names, `--shard` spellings, the aggregator's `--shards 12`, the Dependabot merge gate and its test, the usage lines, the prose in the pipeline guide and three tests); the coverage matrix stays 4. (3) `Spec Main Shape Gate` gains the hourly schedule and publishes the packed spec as artifact `objectstack-spec-<sha>`; other runs reuse it only when a `main` run of this repository built it (artifacts, not `actions/cache`, which is branch-scoped and would let a PR's YAML write what a queue run reads). (4) fifteen one-check workflows folded into one `Repo Gates` job, every check kept as a step name; `Governed Surface Guard`, `Changeset Presence` (its `Changeset Declaration` is required) and `Spec Main Shape Gate` not folded.
- **Required checks:** the live ruleset 11776024 read by the dev names eight contexts (`Lint`, `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Test`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`); the same eight, byte-identical, are produced by the PR's workflows and all passed; none of the fifteen folded names was required, so no ruleset edit is needed for this PR.

- **Measured on PR #12232's own run (`2fbe080c`, a full run because the diff touches `lychee.toml`, a root config):** CI wall 13.1 min, 135.9 runner-min; the twelve shard test steps 6.3 / 10.1 / 12.3 min (min / median / max); `Repo Gates` one job 4.5 min; `Spec Main Shape Gate` 13.7 (no `main` artifact existed yet); `Type Check` 11.1; the whole PR 13.8 min bound by the spec gate. Before (300 runs): `pull_request` 17.3 min and 128 runner-min; `merge_group` 17.5 / 132; `push` 39.3 / 151; the fifteen folded workflows 15 jobs and 16.1 runner-min per PR event. Projected affected speed over the newest 200 `main` commits: 32 % full runs; the median PR selects 45 % of test files.

The card's 8-minute line is therefore carried by #12240 and #12222, not by this PR. **Open question 2 → A:** the hourly warm run stays; the saving is capped by the 1.6-minute build, the compile is the cost #12240 removes from the PR path.
